sentences.text:
T. Sai Karthik vs The State Of Telangana on 20 June, 2023
 Hon'Ble Smt. Justice G. Anupama Chakravarthy
 Criminal Petition No.5409 of 2023
Order:
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri S.Ganesh, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor
appearing for respondent No.1 and perused the record.

entities.text: T. Sai Karthik vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 2. This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 48

2 Cr.P.C. by the petitioner/A.2 seeking to quash the proceedings in Crime No.37 of 2023 registered on the file of Station House Officer, Undavelli Police Station, Jogulamba Gadwal District, for the offence punishable under Section 420 IPC.

entities.text: Undavelli Police Station, Jogulamba Gadwal District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioner contends that though the punishment which can be awarded for the offence under Section 420 IPC is imprisonment for seven years and fine, notice under Section 41-A Cr.P.C. has not been issued to the petitioner.
Therefore, there is every possibility of getting the petitioner arrested by the respondent police.

Learned Additional Public Prosecutor vehemently opposed the contention of the learned counsel for the petitioner by stating that this is a case of cheating and huge amount of innocent persons was involved and therefore, it is not a fit case to quash the proceedings in the subject crime against the petitioner/A.2.
5.

Since the punishment prescribed for the offence alleged against the petitioner may extend to seven years, this Court deems it appropriate to direct the petitioner to appear before the Investigating Officer on 30.06.2023 between 2:00 P.M. and 4:00 P.M. The Investigating Officer shall follow the procedure laid down under Section 41-A Cr.P.C. and also the guidelines formulated by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Arnesh Kumar vs. State of Bihar1 scrupulously.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar vs. State of Bihar1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, the petitioner shall cooperate with the Investigating Officer and furnish the information and documents as sought by him in concluding the investigation.
(2014) 8 SCC 273 GAC, J 6. Accordingly, this Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.
